name: operations
description: Operations record machinery (W061): the pure ops-record service — deterministic audit-trail assembly over the observability contracts (canonical sequence order, one scope, contiguous lineage) with end-to-end verification (ids re-derived, chain digests recomputed, provenance citations re-guarded — any tamper/rewrite refused loudly), and deterministic operational report composition over the trail + event stream (carried counts as data, canonical order, content-addressed report ids). Pure records only (A14): no scraping, no serving, no alerting, no I/O.
